judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass the Senate version of S.B. 2024, which barred marketing, advertising, or selling an e-cigarette product whose container uses cartoon characters, celebrity names, or images resembling candy or other food, whose shape is disguised as a school supply, smart device, headphones, clothing, backpack, cosmetic, or toy, that was made in China, or that contains cannabinoids, alcohol, kratom, kava, or mushrooms. It passed the Texas Senate 20-11; the enacted law also reached products from other countries designated foreign adversaries and products containing tianeptine, and set the penalty at a Class A misdemeanor.
